Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely assumed Universal Music Group’s headquarters were in Santa Monica (confusing operational HQ with corporate HQ) before verification. The problem hinges on the city of the headquarters of the only group larger than Långa nätter’s label (UMG’s corporate HQ is in Hilversum). This misinterpretation of “headquarters” risked steering the search to the wrong city and would lead to an incorrect downstream answer.
